# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps

OPEN = Span(9 * 60, 17 * 60)


class FindGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        worked = [Span(540, 720), Span(780, 1020)]
        self.assertEqual(
            find_gaps(worked, OPEN),
            ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        )

    def test_edges_and_empty_day(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            find_gaps([Span(600, 960)], OPEN),
            [
                "gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)",
                "gap 16:00-17:00 (60 min)"
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            find_gaps([], OPEN),
            ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"]
        )

    def test_full_cover_has_no_gaps(self):
        worked = [Span(540, 800), Span(700, 1020)]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, OPEN), [])

    def test_outside_hours_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps([Span(500, 700)], OPEN)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps([Span(900, 1100)], OPEN)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
